text: Preserve every accepted requirement, public input/output, ten-product maximum, actual per-product navigation, workbook-writing operation/path and unconditional cleanup. Review rejects this artifact for these implementation defects: all three extract transforms receive whole snapshots and ask for invented status/classification fields, so they do not use bounded independent extraction; read_search_result_cards uses an unobserved selector. Explicitly revise the implementation using only existing TaskPlan forms and inspected contracts. Consume complete observationSnapshot.pages through extract with explicit each, one compact result per page; extract observed facts/candidate records with exact text, URLs, references and supported actions only where needed. No invented position, status, CAPTCHA classification or completeness flags in extraction. Those decisions belong in interpretation of the compact facts, with original producer completeness metadata kept separately. Never send the full snapshot to a global transform or as shared extraction context. Preserve all pages, ordering and every observation needed for the decision; the independent result may contain a nested array of observed candidates. Keep global selection of at most ten product links and status interpretation explicit. Do not manufacture page selectors; select exact observed references for interactions, supporting activate, under a direct non-null guard. Capture a fresh complete observation after any interaction. Product pages must actually be visited, independently compacted, then interpreted only from observed facts into the requested business fields with missing fields explicit. Keep conditional outputs compatible and scope exports explicit. Preserve the actual document_write operation and its returned filePath; keep target path literal rather than model-generated. No new public inputs, scripts, limits or removal of requested work. This is an explicit full revision preserving requirements because introducing bounded compaction requires restructuring existing transforms.
